notes.title: FINALLY! Another bug fix
notes.content:
Thanks for bearing with us while we fixed the few bugs that were lingering around. I have finally fixed where it will remember the last position you were at on the overworld map and a few glitches with the joystick movement.

Please let us know if you have found any other bugs! We have a discord channel you can pop in and let us know at: https://discord.gg/qXQQxrW

Thank you all in advance! We look forward to talking to you guys!

notes.title: New release for FS! Lots of fixes.
notes.content:
Thank you for bearing with us while we get some of the bugs fixed in the game. We appreciate your support and hope these changes improve your game play experience! Please use our discord link to report any more bugs you have found or to chat with the developers or learn about future projects that are in the works: [url=https://discord.gg/qXQQxrW]https://discord.gg/qXQQxrW[/url]

[b]Player Controls:[/b]
Added use of arrow keys for convenience for people who do not want to use wasd.

[b]Overworld Map:[/b]
Added a click and drag to the overworld map.
Added navigation with the arrow keys on the overworld map.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed dialog bug where if you hit next level at the end of a world it would skip the dialog room and put it behind.
Fixed bug that would continue to play multiples of the same sound repeatedly.
Fixed damage sound still playing after levels are complete.
Fixed bug with volume on the options menu not going down.

[b]Graphics Changes:[/b]
Edited the Ship bay to reflect hidden levels for 2 ships.
Added an indicator when you discover a hidden level.

Thanks again for all of the positive feedback and support. Don't forget to check out our discord!

notes.title: Officially released!
notes.content:
I'd like to start by saying thank you all for your support during and after the development of this game. What started as a passion project for David and I has evolved into a full game. We really do appreciate all the kind thoughts sent our way. I also want to thank all who had a hand in creating this with your feedback to improve what we already loved and made it better.

We hope you love it as much as we do! Thank you again!

notes.title: Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Fleet Scrapper to be coming soon! Release date is Feb 18th 2019. Please  come back then to be one of the first to get our new game from Creatorship Games! There will be a 15% discount rolling out upon release!

We are excited! We hope you are as well!

Thanks to everyone for their support!
